property_summary: For all callers and any prior sequence of public calls, the reference C.paused() returns the stored _paused flag (so immediately after initialize it is false and after pause() it is true); the mutant always returns true, so there exist fuzzed inputs (choice of whether admin called pause/unpause) where paused() differs.
change_summary: Make paused() always return true regardless of the stored _paused flag.
